summary: strftime formats a date/time using a format string via Python's datetime.strftime (before 2.21 it used time.strftime).
questions: How do I format the current date in Ansible?
What changed in strftime in ansible-core 2.21?

answer_card.title: strftime filter
answer_card.answer_md: `{{ '%Y-%m-%d' | strftime }}` formats a date/time using Python's `datetime.datetime.strftime`. Before ansible-core 2.21 it used `time.strftime`. See the Python docs for all format codes.
